name: mybantu-translation-eval-v1
description: Synthetic trilingual evaluation dataset for MyBantu offline translation. All content is invented (names, addresses, phone numbers, amounts, account and model numbers are fictional). No private customer, school, family, government-account, or company documents were used.

fields.mustPreserve: literal substrings that must appear unchanged (or with only numeral-width normalization) in the translation: numbers, dates, currency amounts, model numbers, error codes, phone numbers, proper names
